About

We named ourselves after the first green thing in a Maine spring.

A small technology company in Portland, Maine — who we are, why we started, and what we do with the work when it goes well.

About FIDDLE,GREEN→ Team→ Supporting Maine→ Testimonials→

A fiddlehead is a fern before it unfurls. It is early, it is local, and it is growing on purpose — which felt like the right thing to be named after.

FIDDLE,GREEN is a Maine technology consultancy built for small organizations. We would rather help something get started well than be the people called in to fix it two years later, and we would rather leave you understanding your own systems than dependent on us for them.

Recent and current work

A sample of what we are working on now. Happy to connect you with a client whose situation looks like yours.

  • Redesigning the website for a Portland restaurant.
  • Helping a nonprofit yoga studio adopt AI and automate its class scheduling.
  • Solving time-sensitive AV problems for a local community orchestra.
  • Building out the technical side of an early-stage pet technology startup.

Maine technology consulting for small businesses, nonprofits, startups, and public agencies.
